# Trader Cockpit

> Trader Cockpit is a Windows desktop app for building, backtesting and stress-testing trading strategies without code, with charts, order flow, paper trading and broker connections. It also publishes free guides to testing a strategy honestly. Nothing here is financial advice.

## What the app does

- [Strategy Builder](https://trader-cockpit.com/features/#builder): Search thousands of rule combinations on the market you pick, with the costs and rules you set.
- [Workflows and robustness checks](https://trader-cockpit.com/features/#workflows): Put a strategy through ordered steps, unattended, and see why strategies drop out.
- [Results](https://trader-cockpit.com/features/#results): See how a strategy really traded, with a plain verdict that says so when it's weak.
- [Portfolio](https://trader-cockpit.com/features/#portfolio): Combine your saved strategies and see their results together.
- [Charts](https://trader-cockpit.com/features/#charts): A full charting workspace on real market data, with indicators, drawings, watchlists and your own Pine scripts.
- [Order flow and profiles](https://trader-cockpit.com/features/#order-flow): See what traded inside each bar on crypto charts, recorded from the exchange's public feed.
- [Apollo assistant](https://trader-cockpit.com/features/#apollo): An assistant beside your work that turns an idea into a strategy you can test. You confirm every change.
- [Models](https://trader-cockpit.com/features/#models): Machine-learning research on your saved markets or a strategy's trades, judged on data held out from the fit.
- [Community](https://trader-cockpit.com/features/#community): Indicators, strategies and ideas inside the app. Use one with a click, and publish your own.
- [Journal](https://trader-cockpit.com/features/#journal): Review executions, research results, routines and decisions in one place, kept on your PC.
- [Market data and import](https://trader-cockpit.com/features/#data): Connect a broker or exchange, or bring your own files, checked row by row.
- [Exports](https://trader-cockpit.com/features/#exports): Take a strategy to your platform, or get a clear reason why it can't match.
- [Paper trading](https://trader-cockpit.com/features/#paper): Practice with simulated money: live on crypto charts, on US stocks with your broker account connected, and on saved history in Bar Replay.
- [Connect your broker](https://trader-cockpit.com/features/#brokers): 31 brokers connect to Trader Cockpit, and your account activity comes into your Journal.
- [Your work stays on your PC](https://trader-cockpit.com/features/#save): Strategies, results, charts and data are saved in your own data folder.

## Guides: start here

- [In-Sample vs Out-of-Sample Backtesting](https://trader-cockpit.com/learn/concepts/out-of-sample.html): what counts as unseen data and how a holdout becomes part of the selection
- [Monte Carlo Simulation for Trading Strategies](https://trader-cockpit.com/learn/concepts/monte-carlo.html): what reshuffling and resampling trades can test, and their limits
- [Trading Strategy Backtest Checklist](https://trader-cockpit.com/strategy-claim-audit-checklist.html): questions to ask about any published backtest result
